evals.prompt: What effects can I put on my full-body photo?
evals.expected_output: Relevant grouped menu, start requirements and a choice question.
assertions: Names compatible effects and their inputs.
No generation or automatic file save.

evals.prompt: Write Street colossus for my sidewalk photo.
evals.expected_output: Frozen effect prompt or unresolved input package with a required city-scale opening still.
assertions: Lists the fitted giant first frame as required when absent.
Keeps the two cuts and one helicopter.
Returns reference roles and parameters in chat.

evals.prompt: Eyes in on an extreme-close portrait with the left eye visible.
evals.expected_output: First-frame eye dive matching the supplied framing.
assertions: Names eye side by frame side.
Maintains no-blink dive and black ending.

evals.prompt: Clones: I need exactly five copies beside me.
evals.expected_output: Five copies plus original stated at each count change, with observed count drift disclosed.
assertions: Distinguishes copies from total figures.
Does not guarantee exact counts.

evals.prompt: Write Canvas for this source clip.
evals.expected_output: Restyle style block, source/environment requirements, audio preservation note and evidence limit.
assertions: Does not load another skill.
Discloses that Canvas was not achieved upstream.
Does not generate or require a test ladder.

evals.prompt: Tracking with readable numbers and a precise HUD.
evals.expected_output: Footage prompt and explicit destination post handoff.
assertions: No readable text or HUD in generated footage.
States that full effect depends on post work.
Does not implement deterministic graphics.

evals.prompt: Mighty fighter from my portrait, preserve the face-last reveal.
evals.expected_output: Separate Shot A and B prompts with role options and a post-cut note.
assertions: Face first appears around five seconds.
Exact hard cut is a destination post need.
Provider rejection is not treated as permission to bypass.

evals.prompt: Make the effect on my missing photo and save everything.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the asset and clarifies effect choice before filling unseen facts.
assertions: No invented image observations.
Saving follows explicit user request with no credentials or signed URLs.

evals.prompt: Prepare the Cyclope first and last still prompts. The seagull flies away at one second.
evals.expected_output: The first still contains one perched seagull; the last still contains none, matching the flight event.
assertions: The last-frame prompt removes the seagull rather than retaining it.
The person, meadow, boulder, sword and camera framing remain continuous.

evals.prompt: Write Lacewalker using my waist-up portrait. My trousers and shoes are outside the frame.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the unseen clothing choice; inserts at most one complete lower-outfit sentence after the user supplies it.
assertions: Does not invent unseen trousers or shoes.
Does not duplicate the phrase The miniature also wears.
For a full-body reference, removes the conditional lower-outfit slot.
